notes: One clean.py pipeline must satisfy seven distinct sub-tasks (grouped boolean-aware aggregation, nested dept->emp->project graph, entity filtering across name/id variants, URL top-k ranking, hourly interpolation with boundary fallback, HTML->JSONL paper extraction, and 20-trial low-rank CSV reconstruction). Hidden cases generalize across three genuinely different inputs including boundary-empty values, boolean-string variants, whitespace/case malformed text, and full-rank matrices with a lower reconstruction rank, so an agent must derive correct logic rather than copy inputs. Difficulty is hard because two competencies (20 per-index low-rank CSV trials; complete two-field JSONL per paper) carry a hard floor, forcing the task above the nominal medium target.
